label: Exists
term: exists (quantifier over individuals in the modal embeddings)
resolution: EXISTS_1 ranges over candidates satisfying P without an actuality guard; EXISTS_2 requires the same witness to satisfy ex at the selected world and P. Distinct inductive proposition types have witness-bearing constructors, not opaque flags or Box aliases. The world-indexed existence predicate remains primitive. The empty-extension control separates domain inhabitation from actual existence. Existing modal embeddings inline these respective formulas; their Box operator does not define either quantifier. RootFacts already supplies actual existence in ExistenceSenseRoute; that certified result is unchanged. No implication from ExistsAt to InAct at esse is supplied. Existing source-navigation context retained: Scott AFP GoedelGod.thy T3/C2 uses the domain reading (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY); GoedelVariantHOML1.thy Ax4, NecExist, Th2/Th3 uses the ex-guarded reading (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY). Property quantifiers are possibilist in both. The new dedicated definitions are analyst interpretations, not new source attribution.
